# Tree (`tree`)

Expandable hierarchy with optional checkboxes.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

`createTree` (types in `dist/web/data-display/tree.d.ts`): `ul.mh-tree` (`role="tree"`, `--checkable`, `--dense`): nested `li.mh-tree__item` (`role="treeitem"` with level, position, `aria-expanded`, `aria-selected` or `aria-checked`, roving `tabindex`), each a `.mh-tree__row` (`__toggle` chevron, `__check`, `__icon`, `__label`, `__meta`) and, when expanded, a `ul.mh-tree__group`.

```ts
export function createTree(options: TreeOptions): TreeHandle;

export interface TreeOptions {
  nodes: readonly TreeNode[];
  /** Accessible name of the tree. */
  label?: string;
  /** Ids of the expanded parents at the start. */
  expanded?: readonly string[];
  /** Single selection (when not `checkable`). */
  selected?: string | null;
  /** Shows a checkbox per item: checking a parent checks everything under it, a partly checked parent is mixed. */
  checkable?: boolean;
  /** Checked ids at the start; a parent id stands for all its leaves. */
  checked?: readonly string[];
  /** Tighter rows. */
  dense?: boolean;
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: string[]) => void;
  /** Called with the checked leaf ids. */
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: string[]) => void;
}

export interface TreeHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  expanded(): string[];
  setExpanded(ids: readonly string[]): void;
  selected(): string | null;
  setSelected(id: string | null): void;
  checked(): string[];
  setChecked(ids: readonly string[]): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createText, createTree, type TreeNode } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const nodes: TreeNode[] = [
  {
    id: 'ground',
    label: 'Ground floor',
    icon: 'home',
    children: [
      { id: 'living', label: 'Living room', meta: '4 devices' },
      { id: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen', meta: '3 devices' },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'upstairs', label: 'Upstairs', icon: 'home', children: [{ id: 'bedroom', label: 'Bedroom' }] },
];

const picked = createText('Selected: kitchen', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const tree = createTree({
  nodes,
  label: 'Rooms',
  expanded: ['ground'],
  selected: 'kitchen',
  onSelect: (id) => (picked.textContent = `Selected: ${id}`),
});

document.body.append(tree.el, picked);
```

## React API

`Tree` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTree`; each of expanded, selected and checked is controlled or uncontrolled.

```ts
export function Tree({
  nodes,
  label,
  expanded,
  defaultExpanded,
  onExpandedChange,
  selected,
  defaultSelected = null,
  onSelect,
  checkable = false,
  checked,
  defaultChecked,
  onCheckedChange,
  dense,
  className,
}: TreeProps);

export interface TreeProps {
  nodes: readonly TreeNode[];
  label?: string;
  /** Controlled expanded ids. */
  expanded?: readonly string[];
  defaultExpanded?: readonly string[];
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: string[]) => void;
  /** Controlled selection (when not `checkable`). */
  selected?: string | null;
  defaultSelected?: string | null;
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  checkable?: boolean;
  /** Controlled checked ids (a parent stands for its leaves). */
  checked?: readonly string[];
  defaultChecked?: readonly string[];
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: string[]) => void;
  dense?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tree } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { TreeNode } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const nodes: TreeNode[] = [
  {
    id: 'ground',
    label: 'Ground floor',
    icon: 'home',
    children: [
      { id: 'living', label: 'Living room', meta: '4 devices' },
      { id: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen', meta: '3 devices' },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'upstairs', label: 'Upstairs', icon: 'home', children: [{ id: 'bedroom', label: 'Bedroom' }] },
];

export function TreeExample() {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string[]>(['ground']);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>('kitchen');
  return (
    <Tree
      nodes={nodes}
      label="Rooms"
      expanded={expanded}
      onExpandedChange={setExpanded}
      selected={selected}
      onSelect={setSelected}
    />
  );
}
```
